goal: A sync over a work source records a source_syncs run -- status=ok with observed_count on success, status=error on a failed list_work -- and a failed pass marks NOTHING disappeared, on both the SQLite and Postgres backends.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00048-orchestrator-persistence-v2.md -- criteria #7 (headline failed-pass safety), #8, the source_syncs part of #10, and decisions D-3, D-4

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- add the source_syncs table to _SCHEMA_SQL (already at version 2 after the prior task) and the start/finish recording methods here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims_postgres.py -- mirror the source_syncs table (BIGSERIAL id, JSONB, TIMESTAMPTZ) and the recording methods

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- reconcile_live_runs / _source_reconcile_loop (lines 164-263): the runtime posture to mirror at the storage layer -- a FAILED list_work interrupts/marks NOTHING; persistence must record the error and leave disappeared_at untouched

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_sources.py -- WorkSource.list_work and DirectoryWorkSource (source_name = tasks_dir path); _github.py GithubWorkSource (source_name = repo) per D-4
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_orchestrator_claims.py -- the sibling store test to keep green and extend in the same both-backends style
conftest.py (repo root) -- postgres_dsn fixture + require_postgres skip so Postgres source_syncs cases auto-skip without Docker
constraints: source_syncs columns: id (autoincrement / BIGSERIAL), source_kind, source_name, started_at, finished_at (nullable), status, observed_count INT default 0, error (nullable), metadata_json. SQLite uses INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT + TEXT; Postgres uses BIGSERIAL + JSONB/TIMESTAMPTZ.

A sync = record source_syncs start -> run list_work() -> on SUCCESS: persist observed items + replace edges + mark absent-as-disappeared (the methods from the prior task) + finish status='ok' with observed_count = number observed and finished_at set; on FAILURE: finish status='error' with a non-empty error and mark NOTHING disappeared (D-3).
source_name follows D-4: directory -> tasks_dir path string; github -> repo (owner/repo).
Implement on BOTH SqliteClaimStore and PostgresClaimStore so criterion #10 holds for source_syncs too.
Grade the STORE end-state (rows present/updated/marked), not a fixed call order.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT change the runtime reconcile_live_runs / _source_reconcile_loop interrupt behavior -- this task persists the catalog/sync; it does not alter who gets interrupted.
Do NOT store telemetry (per-tick poll exhaust, token streams, SDK logs, spans) in source_syncs -- it is operational/decision-analytics STATE only.
Do NOT touch flywheel-core schema, schema_version, or task_versions.
Do NOT modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions.
edge_cases: A FAILED list_work must record a source_syncs row with status='error' and a non-empty error AND leave every previously-seen item's disappeared_at NULL (criterion #7) -- a tracker hiccup is never task disappearance.
observed_count on a successful sync must equal the number of items observed; a constant 0 must fail (criterion #8).
The Postgres source_syncs cases run with Docker and skip (never fail) without it.
